candidate.name: Darmon Rigid Local Systems and Uniform Monodromy
candidate.text: Candidate: Monodromy representations of pi_1(P^1 \ {0, 1, infty}) with conjugacy classes of orders x, y, z. When x, y, z >= 3, the rigid local system has no non-trivial parabolic degenerations, forcing the Galois representation to arise from an automorphic representation of bounded weight.
